//: Copy to mootify.json and fill in. mootify.json is gitignored — never commit the API key.

Lidarr.//: ApiKey also reads from the Lidarr__ApiKey environment variable or a Docker secret.
Lidarr.//QualityProfileId: Pick one WITHOUT FLAC. Lidarr's stock 'Standard' profile is usually id 3.

Library.//MusicRoot: The path THIS app can see. Lidarr's root folder is a path inside its own container, so it is usually a different string. A UNC share works: \\\\host\\Data\\MediaMusic
